customerDecision: Two sealed tins and a scoop need three separate decisions: how the tins are supported, where the scoop can be lifted, and how the filled assembly closes and travels. Measure the finished tins with lids and labels and provide the scoop in its intended protective wrapper. A book-style box can display the complete set, but real fit, closure and transport performance must be checked on representative samples.
